listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (ssbu-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental AArch64 to C/x64 static code plus system runtime, Vulkan with OpenGL fallback. Partial fighter script recovery is not whole-game recovered source. Upstream maturity: Scripted whole1v1 CPU match; several modes only scripted/reachable, World of Light intro only, 3–8players/etc untested; online experimental, rollback incomplete; physical pads unconfirmed. Acquisition: Source ZIP/clone plus Install SSBU.bat; private Python and downloaded runtime/tool releases, local game generation; no Visual Studio stated necessary. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 primary; native Linux one CachyOS/NVIDIA/Wayland whole-match observation, in progress; Steam Deck untested. Original data: Own SSBU13.0.4 or13.0.5 dump and keys; owned updates/DLC applied locally. Firmware explicitly unnecessary; open-source fonts included. Exact regional hashes Unknown in root. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
